valid.code: const operation = { execute: (value: string): string => value };
valid.name: single function property

valid.code: const point = { get x(): number { return 1; }, get y(): number { return 2; } };
valid.name: multiple getters are not a function registry

invalid.code: const operators = { equals: (value: string): boolean => value === 'x', contains: (value: string): boolean => value.includes('x') };
invalid.name: multiple arrow functions

invalid.code: const handlers = { first() { return 1; }, second() { return 2; } };
invalid.name: multiple method shorthands

invalid.code: const mixed = { get id(): number { return 1; }, run: (): void => {}, execute: (): void => {} };
invalid.name: a getter alongside two real function properties is still a registry
